subtitle: Out Manila · Air China
overview: Four nights in local 4-star hotels, flying in and out of Chongqing. See Kuixing Building, Liziba Station, Hongya Cave, the Leshan Giant Buddha by cruise, Guanxian Ancient City and Ciqikou Ancient Town. Flights are with Air China.
travelDatesNote: Departures from Manila, Nov 24–28 2026 to Nov 24–28 2026. The rate changes by date: an amount on a date is added to the base rate per pax. Seats are limited and confirmed at booking.

itinerary.title: Manila – Chongqing
items: Fly Manila to Chongqing (CA482 02:25/06:20); meet the guide.
Visit Kuixing Building (the 22nd floor that feels like the 1st).
Visit Shibati Pedestrian Street and Bayi Food Street (food at your own expense).
Visit Liziba Station, where light rail runs through buildings (2 stations).
Visit Jiefangbei Pedestrian Street and Hongya Cave.
Optional tour: Two Rivers Cruise Night Tour. Meals: B/L/D.

itinerary.title: Chongqing – Leshan – Dujiangyan
items: Hotel breakfast and check out.
Transfer to Leshan; cruise tour of the Leshan Giant Buddha.
Transfer to Dujiangyan and check in.
Optional tour: Night Tour of South Bridge (Blue Tears). Meals: B/L/D.

itinerary.title: Dujiangyan – Chengdu
items: Hotel breakfast and check out.
Visit a latex shop and a Chinese medicine shop.
Visit Zhongshuge bookstore.
Photo stop at the panda statue in Yangtianwo Square.
Visit Guanxian Ancient City.
Transfer to Chengdu.
Optional tour: Panda Valley + BBQ buffet dinner. Meals: B/L/X.

itinerary.title: Chengdu – Chongqing
items: Hotel breakfast and check out.
Visit a silk shop.
Transfer to Chongqing.
Night tour of Nanbin Road and Xiaohaoli Old Street.
Optional tour: dinner at the world’s largest hot pot restaurant, Pipa Yuan. Meals: B/L/X.

itinerary.title: Chongqing – Manila
items: Hotel breakfast and check out.
Visit a jewelry shop.
Visit Ciqikou Ancient Town.
Transfer to airport; fly home (CA481 21:30/01:20+1). Meals: B/L/X.

placeDesc.Kuixing Building: A Chongqing building where the street-level entrance is on the 22nd floor.
placeDesc.Shibati Pedestrian Street: A historic Chongqing district of old stone stairs and lanes.
placeDesc.Bayi Food Street: A street of local Chongqing food stalls; food at your own expense.
placeDesc.Liziba Station: A Chongqing light-rail station where the train runs through a residential building.
placeDesc.Jiefangbei: The central pedestrian shopping square of Chongqing, around a landmark monument.
placeDesc.Hongya Cave: A stilted riverside building complex in Chongqing, popular for its night views.
placeDesc.Leshan Giant Buddha: A UNESCO-listed Buddha carved into a cliff; the tour views it from a river cruise.
placeDesc.Dujiangyan: A city near Chengdu known for its ancient irrigation system and old town.
placeDesc.Zhongshuge Bookstore: A well-known bookstore chain with striking mirrored interior design.
placeDesc.Guanxian Ancient City: The old town of Dujiangyan, with traditional streets and buildings.
placeDesc.Nanbin Road: A riverside road in Chongqing, visited for its night views.
placeDesc.Xiaohaoli Old Street: An old-style street in Chongqing with snack shops, visited on the night tour.
placeDesc.Ciqikou Ancient Town: A restored riverside old town in Chongqing with stone-paved lanes and snack shops.
